name: Pharaoh’s Peace
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 3rd; Slot neck; Price 400 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This plain copper medallion holds an etched falcon and ram, symbols of pharaoh’s dominion over life and death.

EFFECTS

Once per day when the command word is spoken, the wearer gains protection from a specific type of creature. Use in daylight grants the effects of a hide from animals spell; use between sunset and dawn grants the effects of a hide from undead spell. Once used, the medallion becomes faceless and cannot be used again until 24 hours have passed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells hide from animals, hide from undead; Cost 200 gp
